text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — the console "preview" for SLO thresholds is showing ~30% fewer expected notify hits than what the notify system actually fired during the last canary. Noticed after the sampling tweak yesterday. Anyone else see this?
Marta: yup, saw it in tenant-42. Preview shows ~120 events for the window, notify delivered ~170.
Dylan: do we have an example payload or the sampler config used on the canary? wondering if the console aggregation and the notify pipeline are using different sampling windows or dedupe rules.
Priya: here's the policy we pushed (shortened):
```json
{
  "route": "ingress.slo.high-priority",
  "threshold": 0.995,
  "notify": { "enabled": true, "policy": "soft-fanout" },
  "sampling": { "mode": "probabilistic", "rate": 0.6 }
}
```
Marta: that matches what was rolled. console preview code path uses the post-agg counter (we sample after dedupe), notify path samples before dedupe. So ordering mismatch = bigger gap.
oncall-bot: sampler-service deployed "sampler/v2.3.1" at 1739876000 (release-bot)
Samir: yep — this is an ordering issue. Two different places apply sampling+dedupe: metrics ingestion and notification fanout. We need deterministic ordering or a shared contract. Current root cause: console mirrors metrics ingest (post-dedupe) but notify respects pre-dedupe sampling for fairness.
Dylan: options: 1) change console to estimate using pre-dedupe model, 2) change notify to sample post-dedupe, or 3) add an explict "preview_mode" param on the preview API that simulates notify path.
Priya: my vote is (3) — minimal risk and better UX: add a "notify-preview" toggle so admins can see expected notify counts with the exact sampling+dedupe model used for fanout. We should also surface a short explanation in the UI: "Preview uses notify-path simulation".
Marta: +1. also want a column showing quota impact (how many tokens/credits expected) since quota interplay is what product asks about.
Samir: API contract note: we shouldn't break /console/preview behavior; add /console/preview?mode=notify or bump to /v2/preview. Internally implement a shim that runs the same code path as notify. I'll prototype a middleware that accepts a header `X-Preview-Mode: notify`.
Dylan: if we add the header we avoid version churn. Just ensure RBAC and audit logs still record preview requests (product asked for that).
Priya: action items: Samir proto middleware + unit tests, Dylan add RBAC + audit event, Marta add quota column mock in UX prototype, Priya will draft a short RFC and schedule a 15m sync. Can we target a canary for next Tues?
Marta: can do UX mock by EOD Friday.
Samir: I'll drop a branch today and pin the sampler behavior in integration tests.
Dylan: I'll update the preview API docs once we settle header shape.
Priya: thanks team — critical for reducing surprise notifications. :thumbsup:
